title: Three operators, three different outcomes
promptMarkdown: On $\ell^2(\mathbb N)$ determine the kernel, range, cokernel dimension and Fredholm index where defined for the right shift $S$, the left shift $S^*$, and $D(x_n)=(x_n/n)$. Prove the range assertions, including nonclosedness for $D$, and show that $D$ is compact.
hintLadder: Compute coordinatewise and retain the first-coordinate condition.
Approximate $D$ in operator norm, not just pointwise.
